subject: Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
text:
Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
Seismic surveys taking place up to 500 metres east of the multi-user dock, sections 35 and 36 until 010000 UTC Jan 2027. Small boats and barges on site. 
Stay clear 200 metres.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-4156-26
